sections.desc: 播客快照与 10-21 相同：Every 前沿小队纪录片。完整中文译文（38255 字符、62 段）已收录于 10-21 期；今日保留金句回顾。

rewrite: Replay note: today's podcast feed is unchanged from 2026-10-21 — Every's documentary on its Frontier Team (pirates & architects; personal benchmarks; the Wrangler's usage dashboard; the tabless browser; audience.md; the Minga orchestrator; the capability ladder from GPT-4 to Fable 5.1). The full Chinese translation (62 paragraphs) was published in yesterday's issue; today we keep a quote replay.
original: Dan Shipper: Do I get my work done or do I stay up to date with AI and figure out what all these new tools and workflows mean for what work I should do? That's just crazy.
Dan Shipper: There's still a lot of capability overhang… the models are able to do much more than we have had time to try.
Mike Taylor: It's your job now to protect other people's context… I'm regularly accused of saturating the company LinkedIn.
Arielle Shipper: Being able to take some of the ideas that I have and will them into existence is actually a totally new thing.
Jack Cheng: I've never felt such strain on my ability to focus.
Kieran Klaassen: It's very easy to overwhelm the entire organization by just dumping 100 experiments in a channel. Make sure some stick.

original: 【金句回顾】
「是干活、还是跟上 AI？——这太疯狂了。」
「能力过剩还很多：模型能做的远多于我们来得及试的。」
「现在你的工作是保护别人的注意力——我经常被指控灌满公司 Slack。」
「把脑子里的想法『意志成真』，是全新的事。」
「我从未感到专注力承受如此重压。」
「往频道里倒 100 个实验太容易压垮全公司——要确保有些能粘住。这就是前沿小队的工作。」
